High-level proposal: a 60-minute kickoff that covers (1) your objectives and data flow, (2) security/compliance checklist, and (3) pilot timeline + success criteria. For regulated PHI workloads we typically include a short ops preflight with our infra team (30m) + a separate security sync if needed.

Please confirm who will attend from your side (platform, security, CTO if available) and which of these windows next week works (all times EDT):
- Tue 2027-04-06: 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00
- Wed 2027-04-07: 09:00–10:00 or 10:30–11:30

If none of those work, tell us your earliest available morning slot and we'll do our best to accommodate. I'm also attaching a short pilot outline so you can see the typical agenda and artifacts we ask for (SOC2 summary, audit-log access approach).

Hi Jordan and Vivek,

Thanks for the quick reply. We're on Eastern (EDT) and mornings are best. Our CTO Carlos (cc) will join the initial call if it's a technical deep-dive; otherwise I'll bring our Head of Security.

For next week the earliest we can do is Tue 2027-04-06 at 09:00 EDT — that works for Carlos and me. A few asks up front so we can make the session productive:
- Please confirm what evidence we can expect for SOC 2 / audit logs in the pilot (summary or extract).
- KMS integration: we need to know supported KMS vendors and whether bring-your-own-key (BYOK) is supported in the pilot environment.
- Can we split into a 45-minute technical kickoff + 30-minute security follow-up (shorter ops meeting later)? We prefer two focused blocks.

If that's workable, confirm the 09:00 EDT Tue slot and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Emma

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Hi Emma / Carlos — Vivek here from Deployments. Appreciate the clarity on timing and attendees. 09:00 EDT Tue 2027-04-06 is confirmed on our side.

Quick answers to your asks so the kickoff isn't a discovery rabbit hole: 
- SOC2: we can provide a short SOC 2 attestation summary and a sanitized example of the audit-log export schema. I've attached a one-page SOC2 quick sheet that covers what we typically share in pilots. Full SOC artifacts are available under an NDA / enterprise contract.
- KMS: pilot environments support AWS KMS and GCP KMS for BYOK; we can enable customer-managed keys for the pilot but production HSM integrations are part of the Private deployment onboarding.
- Format: we can do 45-minute technical kickoff (architecture & access) followed by a 30-minute security session the same week. If you'd prefer back-to-back on Tue, we can schedule 09:00–09:45 for the tech walkthrough and 10:00–10:30 for the security follow-up.

I've attached a short action-item sheet to accelerate pre-kickoff collection (network ranges, sample data profile, KMS ARN if available). Please fill what you can before Tue.

Attachments: SOC2-Attestation-quick.pdf (stub), pilot-action-item-sheet.xlsx (stub)

Also here's a quick scheduling link if you'd rather pick a different slot: https://calendly.com/redwood-private/pilot-60m

See you Tue at 09:00 EDT (we'll send calendar invites shortly).

— Vivek
Senior Deployment Engineer, Redwood Inference
